evals.prompt: In this repo there's a SQLAlchemy models file at app/models.py defining `class User(Base)` with columns id, email, password_hash, and `class Order(Base)` with columns id, user_id (ForeignKey('user.id')), total_cents. Run docs-diagram er for the User and Order tables.
assertions: the file contains a fenced ```mermaid code block with an erDiagram declaration
the mermaid block is syntactically valid erDiagram syntax (entity blocks and relationship lines, no stray placeholder tokens like {{...}})
both USER and ORDER (or User/Order) appear as entities in the diagram, matching the class names actually defined in app/models.py
the User-Order relationship in the diagram is derived from the real user_id ForeignKey declared in Order, not invented
no entity appears in the diagram that isn't one of User or Order from the source file
the response reports the actual entity/relationship counts detected (e.g. 2 entities, 1 relationship), not vague language

evals.prompt: Run docs-diagram arch on this whole repo to show me the architecture. Assume no subagent/Task tool is available in this environment.
assertions: the codebase analysis is performed sequentially inline with Read/Grep/Glob-equivalent commands rather than spawning parallel subagents
docs/architecture.md is created containing a fenced mermaid graph diagram
every component/node in the diagram corresponds to a file or directory actually found in the repository during analysis (no components invented from generic architecture knowledge)
the response does not claim to have used a Task tool or parallel agents

evals.prompt: docs/security.md already exists in this repo with hand-written content describing our threat model. Run docs-diagram security.
assertions: before overwriting docs/security.md, the response asks the user for confirmation instead of silently overwriting it
the response does not discard or overwrite the existing docs/security.md content without that confirmation
if regeneration proceeds only after a hypothetical confirmation is assumed, the response still explicitly calls out that confirmation step happened
the response lists the four supported diagram types (er, arch, deployment, security) and their output files
the response does not guess a diagram type or generate any diagram content
no file under docs/ is created or modified
no Write, file-creation, or other mutating command is run
the response's final message asks the user which diagram type they want, going no further until that's answered
